māmā́11. mā́ ind. (causing a following ch to be changed to cch, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 74) not, that not, lest, would that not, RV. &c. &c.161686804,1

<H1A><h><key1>mā</key1><key2>mā́</key2></h><body>  a particle of prohibition or negation = <lang>Gk.</lang> <gk>μή</gk>, most commonly joined with the Subjunctive <ab>i.e.</ab> the augmentless form of a past tense (<ab>esp.</ab> of the <ab>aor.</ab>, <ab>e.g.</ab> mā́ no vadhīr indra, do not slay us, O <s1>Indra</s1>, <ls>RV.</ls>; mā bhaiṣīḥ or mā bhaiḥ, do not be afraid, <ls>MBh.</ls>; tapovana-vāsinām uparodho mā bhūt, let there not be any disturbance of the inhabitants of the sacred grove, <ls>Śak.</ls>; often also with sma, <ab>e.g.</ab> mā sma gamaḥ, do not go, <ls>Bhag.</ls> <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Pāṇ. iii, 3, 175</ls>; <ls n="Pāṇ. iii, 3">176</ls>; in the sense of ‘that not, lest’ also yathā mā, <ab>e.g.</ab> yathā mā vo mṛtyuḥ pari-vyatkā iti, that death may not disturb you, <ls>PraśnaUp.</ls>; or mā yathā, <ab>e.g.</ab> mā bhūt kālā<srś>tyayo yathā, lest there be any loss of time, <ls>R.</ls>; mā na with <ab>aor.</ab> <ab>Subj.</ab> = <ab>Ind.</ab> without a negative, <ab>e.g.</ab> mā dviṣo na vadhīr mama, do slay my enemies, <ls>Bhaṭṭ.</ls> <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Vām. v, 1, 9</ls>; rarely with the augmentless <ab>impf.</ab> with or without sma, <ab>e.g.</ab> mai<srś>nam abhibhāṣathāḥ, do not speak to him, <ls>R.</ls>; mā sma karot, let him not do it, <ls>Pāṇ. vi, 4, 74</ls>, <ab>Sch.</ab>; exceptionally also with the <ab>Ind.</ab> of the <ab>aor.</ab>, <ab>e.g.</ab>, mā kālas tvām aty-agāt, may not the season pass by thee, <ls>MBh.</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Pāṇ. vi, 4, 75</ls>, <ab>Sch.</ab>)</body><tail><L>161686.05</L><pc>804,1</pc></tail></H1A>

<H1A><h><key1>mā</key1><key2>mā́</key2></h><body>  or with the <ab>Impv.</ab> (in <ls>RV.</ls> only <ls n="RV.">viii, 103, 6</ls>, mā no hṛṇītām [<ls>SV.</ls> hṛṇītās] agníḥ, may <s1>Agni</s1> not be angry with us; but very often in later language, <ab>e.g.</ab> mā kranda do not cry, <ls>MBh.</ls>; gaccha vā mā vā, you can go or not go, <ls>ib.</ls>; ripur ayam mā jāyatām, may not this foe arise, <ls>Śāntiś.</ls>; also with sma, <ab>e.g.</ab> mā sma kiṃ cid vaco vada do not speak a word, <ls>MBh.</ls>)<info lex="inh"/></body><tail><L>161686.10</L><pc>804,1</pc></tail></H1A>

<H1A><h><key1>mā</key1><key2>mā́</key2></h><body>  or with the <ab>Pot.</ab> (<ab>e.g.</ab> mā yamam paśyeyam, may I not see <s1>Yama</s1>; <ab>esp.</ab> mābhujema in <ls>RV.</ls>)<info lex="inh"/></body><tail><L>161686.15</L><pc>804,1</pc></tail></H1A>

<H1A><h><key1>mā</key1><key2>mā́</key2></h><body>  or with the <ab>Prec.</ab> (only once in mā bhūyāt, may it not be, <ls>R. [B.] ii, 75, 45</ls>)<info lex="inh"/></body><tail><L>161686.20</L><pc>804,1</pc></tail></H1A>

<H1A><h><key1>mā</key1><key2>mā́</key2></h><body>  or sometimes with the <ab>fut.</ab> (= that not, lest, <ab>e.g.</ab> mā tvāṃ śapsye, lest I curse thee, <ls>MBh.</ls> <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Vop. xxv, 27</ls>)<info lex="inh"/></body><tail><L>161686.25</L><pc>804,1</pc></tail></H1A>

<H1A><h><key1>mā</key1><key2>mā́</key2></h><body>  or with a participle (<ab>e.g.</ab> mā jīvanyo duḥkhadagdho jīvati, he ought not to live who lives consumed by pain, <ls>Pañcat.</ls>; gataḥ sa mā, he cannot have gone, <ls>Kathās.</ls>; maī<srś>vamprā<srś>rthyam, it must not be so requested, <ls>BhP.</ls>)<info lex="inh"/></body><tail><L>161686.30</L><pc>804,1</pc></tail></H1A>

<H1A><h><key1>mā</key1><key2>mā́</key2></h><body>  sometimes for the simple negative na (<ab>e.g.</ab> katham mā bhūt, how may it not be, <ls>Kathās.</ls>; mā gantum arhasi, thou oughtest not to go, <ls>R.</ls>; mā bhūd āgataḥ, can he not <ab>i.e.</ab> surely he <pb n="804,2"/> must have arrived, <ls>Amar.</ls>)<info lex="inh"/></body><tail><L>161686.35</L><pc>804,1</pc></tail></H1A>

<H1A><h><key1>mā</key1><key2>mā́</key2></h><body>  occasionally without a verb (e. <ab>g.</ab> mā śabdaḥ or śabdam, do not make a noise, <ls>Hariv.</ls>; mā nāma rakṣiṇaḥ, may it not be the watchmen, <ls>Mṛcch.</ls>; mā bhavantam analaḥ pavano vā, may not fire or wind harm thee, <ls>Vām. v, 1, 14</ls>; <ab>esp.</ab> = not so, <ab>e.g.</ab> mā prātṛda, not so, O <s1 n="Prātṛda">Pr˚</s1>, <ls>ŚBr.</ls>; in this meaning also mā mā, mā mai<srś>vam, mā tāvat)<info lex="inh"/></body><tail><L>161686.40</L><pc>804,2</pc></tail></H1A>

<H1A><h><key1>mā</key1><key2>mā́</key2></h><body>  in the <s1>Veda</s1> often with u (mó<srś>) = and not, nor (<ab>e.g.</ab> mā́ maghónaḥ pári khyatam mó<srś> asmā́kam ṛ́ṣṇām, do not forget the rich lords nor us the poets, <ls>RV. v, 65, 6</ls>; and then usually followed by ṣú = sú, <ab>e.g.</ab> mo<srś> ṣú ṇaḥ nírṛtir vadhīt, let not <s1 n="Nírṛtir">N˚</s1> on any account destroy us, <ls n="RV.">i, 38, 6</ls>)<info lex="inh"/></body><tail><L>161686.45</L><pc>804,2</pc></tail></H1A>

<H1A><h><key1>mā</key1><key2>mā́</key2></h><body>  in <ls>ŚBr.</ls> sma mā — mó sma = neither — nor (in a prohibitive sense). <info lex="inh"/></body><tail><L>161686.50</L><pc>804,2</pc></tail></H1A>

māmā22. mā cl. 3. P. mímāti (accord. to Dhātup. xxv, 6 Ā. mimīte; SV. mimeti; Pot. mimīyat, Kāṭh.; pf., mimāya; aor. ámīmet Subj. mīmayat; inf. mā́tavaí),
to sound, bellow, roar, bleat (esp. said of cows, calves, goats &c.), RV.; AV.; Br. :
Intens., only pr. p. mémyat, bleating (as a goat), RV. i, 162, 2.161693804,2

māmā33. mā cl. 2. P. (Dhātup. xxiv, 54) māti;
cl. 3. Ā. (xxv, 6) mímīte;
cl. 4. Ā. (xxvi, 33) māyate (Ved. and ep. also mimāti, Pot. mimīyāt, Impv., mimīhi; Pot. mimet, Br.; pf. mamaú, mame, mamiré, RV.; aor. ámāsi, Subj. mā́sātai, AV.; amāsīt Gr.; Prec. māsīṣṭa, meyāt, ib.; fut. mātā; māsyati, māsyate, ib.; inf. -mé, -maí, RV.; mātum, Br.; ind.p. mitvā́, -mā́ya, RV. &c. &c.),
to measure, mete out, mark off, RV. &c. &c.;
to measure across = traverse, RV.;
to measure (by any standard), compare with (instr.), Kum.;
(māti) to correspond in measure (either with gen., ‘to be large or long enough for’, BhP.; or with loc., ‘to find room or be contained in’, Inscr.; Kāv.; or with na and instr., ‘to be beside one's self with’, Vcar.; Kathās.);
to measure out, apportion, grant, RV.;
to help any one (acc.) to anything (dat.), ib., i, 120, 9;
to prepare, arrange, fashion, form, build, make, RV.;
to show, display, exhibit (amimīta, ‘he displayed or developed himself’, iii, 29, 11), ib.;
(in phil.) to infer, conclude;
to pray (yācñā-karmaṇi), Naigh. iii, 19 :
Pass. mīyáte (aor. amāyi);
to be measured &c., RV.; &c.
Caus., māpayati, ˚te (aor. amīmapat, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 93, Vārtt. 2 Pat.),
to cause to be measured or built, measure, build, erect, Up.; GṛS.; MBh. &c.:
Desid. mitsati, ˚te, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 54; 58 (cf. nir-√ mā) :
Intens. memīyate, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 66. 161697804,2

804,1:H1A:mA/: a particle of prohibition or negation = Gk. μή, most commonly joined with the Subjunctive i.e. the augmentless form of a past tense (esp. of the aor., e.g. mā no vadhīr indra, do not slay us, O Indra, RV.; mā bhaiṣīḥ or mā bhaiḥ, do not be afraid, MBh.; tapovana-vāsinām uparodho mā bhūt, let there not be any disturbance of the inhabitants of the sacred grove, Śak.; often also with sma, e.g. mā sma gamaḥ, do not go, Bhag. cf. Pāṇ. iii, 3, 175; 176; in the sense of ‘that not, lest’ also yathā mā, e.g. yathā mā vo mṛtyuḥ pari-vyatkā iti, that death may not disturb you, PraśnaUp.; or mā yathā, e.g. mā bhūt kālātyayo yathā, lest there be any loss of time, R.; mā na with aor. Subj. = Ind. without a negative, e.g. mā dviṣo na vadhīr mama, do slay my enemies, Bhaṭṭ. cf. Vām. v, 1, 9 ; rarely with the augmentless impf. with or without sma, e.g. mainam abhibhāṣathāḥ, do not speak to him, R.; mā sma karot, let him not do it, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 74, Sch.; exceptionally also with the Ind. of the aor., e.g., mā kālas tvām aty-agāt, may not the season pass by thee, MBh.; cf. Pāṇ. vi, 4, 75, Sch.)161686.05

804,2:H1A:mA/: in the Veda often with u (mo) = and not, nor (e.g. mā maghonaḥ pari khyatam mo asmākam ṛṣṇām, do not forget the rich lords nor us the poets, RV. v, 65, 6; and then usually followed by ṣu = su, e.g. mo ṣu ṇaḥ nirṛtir vadhīt, let not N˚ on any account destroy us, i, 38, 6)161686.45
804,2:H1A:mA/: in ŚBr. sma mā — mo sma = neither — nor (in a prohibitive sense). 161686.50
